policy_text: Eligible unused items may be returned within 30 days of delivery. Final-sale items are not returnable.
Approved refunds are sent to the original payment method. Processing may take 5 to 10 business days after approval.
Standard shipping estimates are 3 to 5 business days. Carrier delays can extend delivery.
Customers can view current order status using the order tracking link in their confirmation email.
A pending authorization is not a completed charge and typically clears according to the customer's bank schedule.
Customers should report damaged items with the order number and photos so support can review available resolutions.
